title: Finite ball cover of a compact Hausdorff-null set with small Σσ_j^m (covering step of Simon 7.5.11)
statement: Let P, m ∈ ℕ and let Z ⊆ ℝ^P (Euclid P = EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin P)) be compact with μH[m](Z) = 0, where μH[m] is Mathlib's m-dimensional Hausdorff measure. Then for all real ε > 0 and δ > 0 there exist J ∈ ℕ, points p_1, …, p_J ∈ Z and radii σ_1, …, σ_J ∈ ℝ such that 0 < σ_j < δ for every j, Z ⊆ B(p_1, σ_1) ∪ … ∪ B(p_J, σ_J) (open balls), and Σ_{j=1}^J σ_j^m < ε.
lean_statement: ∀ (P m : ℕ) (Z : Set (Euclid P)), IsCompact Z → μH[(m : ℝ)] Z = 0 → ∀ ε δ : ℝ, 0 < ε → 0 < δ → ∃ (J : ℕ) (p : Fin J → Euclid P) (σ : Fin J → ℝ), (∀ j, p j ∈ Z) ∧ (∀ j, 0 < σ j ∧ σ j < δ) ∧ Z ⊆ ⋃ j, ball (p j) (σ j) ∧ ∑ j, σ j ^ m < ε
